why: A standout individual line is the only per-player content trigger available from settled nflverse data, and it is the trigger with the shortest shelf life.
notes: goodperformance is status:design in passive-income-dev, so this enqueues a CANDIDATE task (see R001 notes). The one-per-player-per-day throttle is what stops a Sunday slate from becoming a dozen tasks for the same athlete; the identity hash on (player, game) is what stops an nflverse stat correction from firing a second one.
